headline: Gold and silver steady today after a sharp fall over the past week
summary: Today's change is zero for 24k and 22k gold and for silver, so the national rates were unchanged from yesterday. Compared with seven days ago, 24k gold is down about 9.1% (₹1,254 per gram) and silver is down about 10.3% (₹20,000 per kg), and over the last 28 days silver has fallen about 20% from its high of ₹2,20,000 per kg on 26 October. Likely drivers include the softer international prices, a firmer US dollar against the rupee, and seasonal shifts in jewellery demand, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: With no move today and prices well below last month, there is no urgency; if you plan to buy, compare making charges and GST across jewellers before deciding.
